summary.headline:
Payment backends and an in-house deployment platform:
designed, built and run
summary.intro: I built the backend of a payment service and a deployment platform on Kubernetes that every team shares, and moved incident handling into runbooks and automation so ==new hires run it by the same rules==.
cards: TARGET ROLE
Backend platform engineering, payment systems, internal developer platforms
FOCUS
Payment authorization and settlement backends, a Kubernetes deployment platform, event-driven design
STRENGTHS
Narrowing incidents down layer by layer, and turning repeated operations into automation
INDUSTRIES
Payments, e-commerce, early-stage startup

about: At Gamma Labs, which I co-founded during college, I owned the API server and its operation. I learned that deciding what to build first is what keeps a launch.
At Beta Commerce I published order state changes as events so settlement and notifications no longer depended on the order service. Cutting the paths failures spread along drew me to payments.
At Alpha Pay I split authorization into its own deployments, then gathered every team's deployments into one shared path.
motivation: I want to build the platform that keeps services running where a stop means an immediate loss, such as payments and orders.
